audience: HR and people teams that check employee absences in absence.io

useCases.title: See who is absent and why
useCases.text: List the absence records with an optional filter, then look up the users behind them. Ask the assistant who is absent.

useCases.title: Read one absence record and its employee
useCases.text: Open one absence record by its id. Then read the user record of the employee it belongs to.

useCases.title: Review the absences of one employee
useCases.text: Filter the absence records to one employee and read the matching user record. Ask the assistant to summarize their absences.

useCases.title: Browse the users of your account
useCases.text: Page through the users of the account, and open one user to read the record.
